name: TableHeaderCell
description: A table header cell (<th>). scope=col (default) carries an optional three-state DS-Icon sort control and aria-sort; scope=row marks the identifying cell of a body row so screen readers announce the row context with every other cell.

usage.description: TableHeaderCell names a column or row with correct scope semantics, and hosts sortable column headers driven by useTableSortable; sort state is announced via aria-sort, never by caret colour alone.

ariaRequirements: native <th> with an explicit scope (col or row)
sortable column headers expose aria-sort and toggle via an inner button
the sort caret is decorative (aria-hidden); state is carried by aria-sort, never the icon alone
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-27 — th with explicit scope; aria-sort on active column headers; decorative caret; row-header (scope=row) verified to name its row; axe asserted inside a table in the unit test. 2026-08-04 — Phase 1 pass: light/dark/forced-colors verified in a real browser; axe clean across all stories x 3 modes; AT-tree and real-browser forced-colors evidence captured; keyboard sort cycle and selection driven by play stories at the Table composition level.

dense: th with scope col/row; col carries the three-state sort caret + aria-sort, row names its data row

scope.description:
Header scope. `col` (default) labels a column; `row` makes the cell the
accessible name for its row — use it on the identifying cell of each body
row so screen readers announce the row context with every other cell.

sortable.description: Renders the sort affordance and toggles on click. Only for column headers.

sortDirection.description: Current sort state; drives `aria-sort` and the caret icon.

onSort.description: Called when a sortable header is activated.

forbiddenUse: make a scope=row header sortable — row headers are not sort controls
convey sort state with the caret colour alone
